findings.title: ActiveWorkout hardcodes rpeMode/smartRest/autoStart instead of reading UserSettings
findings.detail: src/components/workout/ActiveWorkout.tsx sets `rpeMode = 'RPE'`, `smartRestEnabled = true`, `autoStartRest = true` as local constants rather than reading them from settingsStore/UserSettings. UserSettings.rpeMode and the smart-rest/auto-start flags exist and are wired through SettingsForm, so the plumbing is present; the active-workout surface just isn't consuming them yet. Functionally harmless (defaults match the design's recommended behavior) and does not affect any AC, but it means a user who selects RIR or disables smart rest in settings won't see it reflected in the live workout screen. Low priority follow-up.

summary: The ForgeFit implementation faithfully follows the approved design contract. The guarded lazy Firebase singleton (config.ts) performs no module-level initializeApp(), returns null getters under empty env, is client-only, and uses getApps()/getApp() for HMR safety (NFR-1/AC-1/2/3). The data model, nested Firestore tree, and converters match C.3/C.4 exactly — converters omit absent optionals via present() (never emit null), SetLog honors the actualReps/durationSeconds XOR, and schemaVersion is stamped. firestore.rules and storage.rules are the verbatim C.9 contract: default-deny with no wildcard and no `allow ... if true`, owns(uid)+uid-stamp policy, COMPLETED-session immutability with only the summaryApplied false->true toggle permitted (onlySummaryAppliedChanged), parentOpen() create-gate closing the append hole, and validSet/validSession/validBody/validRecovery field bounds; the storage read/write split is correct (AC-4/5/11). The AuthGuard 6-phase machine in authStore only redirects on 'unauthenticated' and renders a full-screen loader during both loading phases, so there is no dashboard flash (AC-16). Pure libs are correct: Epley 1RM (AC-8), kg-canonical units with drift-free round-trip (AC-12), and double-progression covering all six recommendation types plus smart rest (FR-9). The offline/sync completion is decomposed per C.7 — Step 2 is gated on waitForPendingWrites (the HIGH-1 flush barrier) and writes a deterministic-ID batch flipping sessionCompleted, and Step 3 is a separate transaction idempotent on the per-session summaryApplied marker (AC-9/10/11). The two prior review findings are genuinely resolved: ActiveWorkout.handleFinish now routes completion through the composite op (syncService.buildCompleteSessionOp + runCompleteSession), forwards the deduped pendingCelebration PRs (deterministic ids via buildPersonalRecords) so personalRecords/{id} is persisted (AC-7), and builds a populated weekly/monthly summary delta (FR-28); ActiveWorkout.test.tsx locks this. The MON-SUN seed split, PR engine, dashboard today-selection (AC-13), backup schema-version policy (AC-14), and PWA manifest/SW (AC-15) are all present and match the design. The service boundary holds — the only firebase/* imports in components/stores are erased `import type`. Every creds/emulator/Lighthouse/manual-audit item (AC-3, AC-10, AC-4/5/11 rule assertions, AC-15 installability, NFR-6) is honestly marked 'needs verification during implementation' rather than falsely claimed done, consistent with the no-creds/no-emulator environment. One NIT (active-workout screen hardcodes rpeMode/smart-rest flags instead of reading UserSettings) is non-blocking and affects no acceptance criterion.
